text:
maya: Quick Q for the Northstar POC — idp connector issues. SCIM bulk provisioning keeps failing on group updates when email canonicalization differs across providers. Anyone seen this?

andrew: Yup. Seen that a lot with Azure AD -> Okta mappings. Can you paste the error payload? Usually it's a 4xx on /Groups with member not found.

maya: Error snippet from their logs: `HTTP 207 Multi-Status`
```
{ "bulk": [ { "type": "Group", "status": 409, "detail": "member not found: user@corp.com" } ] }
```

jordan: Sales side question — Northstar wants domain-locking so only verified company domains can SSO. They asked if we support locking by assertion (e.g. `email.domain`) and whether SCIM tenant isolation can enforce it. Also need a quick callout on Dedicated pricing vs Hosted for a multi-corp POC.

andrew: We support assertion mapping for `NameID` and attribute-based mapping. For domain-locking we recommend a combo: SAML assertion + post-auth domain check + SCIM tenant tag. For POC: Hosted is fastest to validate flows, Dedicated only if they need guaranteed throughput or strict data isolation. I can sketch a one-page price delta.

andrew: Note on SCIM partial failures — runtime returns 207 but we persist per-resource status in audit logs. We expose a retry endpoint; idempotency keys are supported.

chris: From security/compliance: confirm behaviour for partial SCIM failures and data retention. We mark failed resources and do not auto-delete anything unless explicitly requested. For GDPR requests we can run per-tenant retention sweeps; requires retention policy configured (default 365d). Also need proof of SAML metadata handling for their infra team.

maya: Can someone give me a short preflight checklist I can send to Northstar SRE? They asked specifically for: SAML metadata, SCIM base URL + auth method, preferred subject format, list of admin delegates, expected peak QPS, and any RBAC mapping examples.

andrew: On it — quick checklist below you can forward:
- SAML: metadata XML, entityID, ACS URL, NameID format (email, transient), optional attribute mappings
- SCIM: base URL, auth header (Bearer token), supported operations (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/GET), bulk support and idempotency header usage
- RBAC: example mapping `scim.groups:admins -> role:admin`, `scim.groups:devs -> role:editor`
- Domain controls: verified domains list, enforcement mode (audit|enforce)
- Performance: expected peak QPS and avg user size (members per group)
- Security: retention policy, encryption at rest, KMS key_id if using Private

jordan: I already put together a tentative POC commercial: 4-week POC on Hosted (free credits) + optional Dedicated add-on for scale testing. I added a note about potential org-level discounts if they convert within 60 days.

salesbot: Quote created: https://redwood.example/quote/PR-8742; POC checklist uploaded: https://redwood.example/pocexports/NS-2751-checklist.pdf

maya: Perfect — send the quote link and checklist to their SRE and cc me. Also can we flag the SCIM canonicalization issue as a potential blocker for go/no-go? They want a mitigation plan.

andrew: Will add mitigation: 1) normalize emails on inbound SCIM (lowercase + strip aliases) 2) add preflight member-resolve step during bulk ops 3) fallback to manual reconciliation for unresolved members. I'll include expected engineering effort (2-3 days) in the note.

chris: I'll prepare a short security blurb about retention + audit trail for the preflight doc.

maya: Awesome, thanks all. I'll sync with Northstar tomorrow at 10am PT and send any follow-ups here. :thumbsup:
